name: vtesitaly-site
description: Official multilingual website for the Italian VTES community (Astro, deployed via SSH tar-pipe).
author: VTES Italy

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/fetch-albums.mjs && node scripts/build-thumbnails.mjs && node scripts/build-poster-variants.mjs
scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs && pagefind --site dist
scripts.test:build: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.check:dist: npm run check:pages && npm run check:links
scripts.ci:verify: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:build && npm run check:dist

//overrides: esbuild: aliased to esbuild-wasm (same API, no native binary) because Smart App Control on the dev machine blocks the unsigned esbuild.exe; build-time only, does not affect the static deploy.
